notes: Cuiabá (MT, Brazil) is a bus-only city — no metro/light-rail/BRT/suburban rail exists, so all routes are route_type=3 (correct; no rail mode to prioritise). Caribus operates ~22-23 routes / ~618-661 stops per Moovit. This feed covers 3 fully-evidenced flagship routes with complete ordered stop sequences extracted from official Moovit stop-list PDFs (appassets.mvtdev.com/map/131/l/1762/<id>.pdf, where <id> = the Moovit line id): 711 Pedra 90 / Estação Alencastro (the long ~45km flagship line, both directions: 62 stops to Pedra 90 via pattern 409116, 55 stops to Alencastro), 507 Tijucal / Estação Bispo (both directions: 33 + 29 stops, id 382824), and 508 Osmar Cabral / Estação Bispo (47 stops to Osmar Cabral, id 382825). Stop NAMES and ORDER are faithful to the source PDFs (high confidence). SERVICE HOURS per direction are taken verbatim from the PDFs (711 Pedra 90 05:30-23:45 daily; 711 Alencastro 04:30-22:40; 507 Tijucal 06:20-21:53 Mon-Fri, Sat 06:10-11:50, no Sunday; 507 Bispo 05:05-21:20; 508 Osmar 05:35-21:58 Mon-Fri + Sat, no Sunday). One representative mid-morning trip per direction is emitted with even inter-stop spacing across the published trip duration (711=65/64min, 507=47/33min, 508=58min); a full frequency-expanded set was not generated (confidence lowered accordingly). COORDINATES: terminals/landmarks are verified WGS-84 from OSM/guiamapa/Foursquare/Apple (Estação Alencastro -15.5974,-56.0960; Estação Bispo Dom José -15.6014,-56.0979; Instituto de Linguagens UFMT -15.6230,-56.0627; Terminal Pedra 90 -15.6324,-55.9509; Terminal Osmar Cabral ~-15.662,-56.057). Intermediate address-level stops are interpolated monotonically along their known named avenues (Av. Fernando Corrêa da Costa, BR-364/Ayrton Senna, Av. Tatsumi Koga, Av. Newton Rabello de Castro, Av. Dr. Meirelles, Av. Edson Luís da Silva, Av. Carlos Ador de Souza) between verified anchors — positions are approximate (±100-400m) but corridor-correct, not invented. Remaining ~19 Caribus lines (A02/A06/103/403/720/721 etc.) were not built here (would require fetching each line's PDF). No stop was invented; every stop name comes directly from a Moovit PDF. Sources: moovitapp.com line 857832 + appassets.mvtdev.com PDFs; onibus.online; cittamobi. Rápido Cuiabá (a separate operator, Moovit id 857830) is NOT included — 720/721 belong to it, not Caribus.
